info.title: Navixy Eco Fleet API
info.summary: Fuel data resampling and fuel sensor quality scoring
info.description:
This is an API reference for the Navixy Eco Fleet API, which resamples fuel and movement data onto a uniform time grid and scores the quality of fuel sensor readings.

**This API differs from the Platform API in four ways**, so read the operations rather than assuming the usual conventions:

- The base path is `/eco_fleet/v1`, not `/v2`. Older documentation omitted the `/v1` segment, and requests without it are rejected by the platform router before reaching this service.
- Identifiers are **path parameters**, and the period is a **query parameter**.
- Successful responses are **CSV** or a bare JSON object. There is no `success` envelope.
- Errors follow **RFC 7807 problem details**, with a string `type` identifier rather than the numeric `status.code` the Platform API uses.

**Credentials** are the same as the Platform API: a session hash or an API key in the `Authorization` header. A request without one returns 401 with type `errors/default/unauthorized`.

tags.name: Eco Fleet
tags.description: Resampling fuel and movement data onto a uniform time grid, and scoring how noisy a fuel sensor's readings are.

post.description:
Return fuel, speed, movement and location values resampled onto a uniform time grid, as CSV.

Columns are `Time`, one column per fuel sensor named after that sensor, `SPEED` in km/h, `MOVEMENT` where 0 is parking, 1 is moving and 2 is idle, `LNG`, and `LAT`. A tracker with no fuel sensors returns the `Time` column alone.

Timestamps follow the timezone the tracker is located in.

parameters.name: tracker_id
parameters.description: ID of the tracker, also known as object_id. Must belong to the authorized user and must not be blocked.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Period to analyse, as an ISO 8601 interval. Defaults to the last week.

resampling_props.description: How to resample each data type.

csv.summary: A tracker with one fuel sensor

400.description: Bad request, or the period could not be parsed.

502.description: The Navixy Platform API could not be reached, or returned an error. Type `errors/external-api/navixy`, with the underlying code and message in `detail`.

get.description:
Return a quality index for a fuel sensor, calculated from its readings over the given period.

A higher `smoothness` means less noise in the readings; a lower value means more noise.

parameters.name: tracker_id
parameters.description: ID of the tracker which has the sensor.

parameters.name: sensor_id
parameters.description: ID of the sensor to analyze.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Sensor readings' datetime interval to analyse, as an ISO 8601 interval. Defaults to the last week.

200.description: The quality index. Note there is no `success` envelope.

400.description: Bad request. Also returned as type `errors/sensors/quality/not-enough-readings` when the interval holds too few readings: use a period with more vehicle usage, or increase the sending frequency and wait for data to accumulate.

404.description: Sensor or calibration table is missing. Type `errors/entity/not-found`.

502.description: The Navixy Platform API could not be reached, or returned an error. Type `errors/external-api/navixy`, with the underlying code and message in `detail`.

api_key.description: Either a user session hash or an API key, with the "NVX " prefix, for example "NVX 22eac1c27af4be7b9d04da2ce1af111b". The same credential the Platform API uses.
api_key.name: Authorization

Score.description: An abstract measurement score, from 1.0 to 10.0 inclusive.

ResamplingProp.description: How one data type should be resampled.

resampling_method.description: How to fill a gap. `FOLLOWING` fills from the next known value, for data missing at the end of a series. `PREVIOUS` fills from the previous known value, for data missing at the beginning. `MEDIAN_IN_WINDOW` suits evenly distributed data that is not normally distributed. `AVERAGE_IN_WINDOW` and `AVERAGE` suit normally distributed data that is not evenly distributed.

delta.description: Window size in seconds, where the method uses one.

fixed_value.description: A constant to use instead of a computed value, where applicable.

Problem.description: Error response, following RFC 7807 problem details. Note this is not the Platform API error shape: there is no `success` field and no numeric `status.code`.

type.description: Error type identifier, for example `errors/entity/not-found`, `errors/external-api/navixy`, `errors/sensors/quality/not-enough-readings`, or `errors/default/unauthorized`. `about:blank` for generic HTTP errors.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

detail.description: What went wrong. For `errors/external-api/navixy` this carries the underlying Platform API code and message.

instance.description: Path of the request that failed, relative to the base path.
